name: VisibilitySplat
definition: A two-stage inverse rendering pipeline for 3DGS that augments the standard rasterized pipeline with a sparse visibility oracle to estimate transmittance-weighted occlusion for Gaussian primitives from sampled lighting directions, enabling material and light decomposition.
summary: VisibilitySplat is a two-stage inverse rendering pipeline for 3D Gaussian Splatting that uses a sparse visibility oracle to estimate occlusion, enabling robust material and light decomposition under unknown illumination.
